panels.title: Онлайн
panels.description: Клиентов на нодах выбранных панелей прямо сейчас

targets.expr: sum(rwmon_node_online_users{panel_title=~"$panel"})

panels.title: Ноды
panels.description: Выключенные в панели ноды и ноды из exclude_nodes не считаются

targets.expr: sum(rwmon_node_connected{panel_title=~"$panel"})
count(rwmon_node_connected{panel_title=~"$panel"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Хосты
panels.description: Хосты с тегами MONITORING / MONITORING_LITE. Сбой — не проходит хотя бы одна проверка

targets.expr: count(count by (panel, host) (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel"}))

count(count by (panel, host) ((rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="xray"}) == 0) or (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="warp"}) == 0) or (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="psiphon"}) == 0))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Сеть нод сейчас
panels.description: Скорость сетевых интерфейсов всех серверов нод: RX — принято сервером, TX — отправлено

targets.expr: sum(rwmon_node_network_rx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * 8
sum(rwmon_node_network_tx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * 8

panels.title: Трафик клиентов
panels.description: Сколько клиенты скачали и отправили через все ноды за выбранный период

targets.expr: sum(increase(rwmon_node_inbound_upload_bytes{panel_title=~"$panel"}[$__range]) + increase(rwmon_node_inbound_download_bytes{panel_title=~"$panel"}[$__range]))
sum(rwmon_users{status="ACTIVE", panel_title=~"$panel"})
sum(rwmon_users_online{period="lastDay", panel_title=~"$panel"})

panels.title: Ноды
panels.description: Связь — нода подключена к панели. Подкл./WARP/Psiphon — проверки хостов, которые смотрят на IP этой ноды; «Из РФ» — открывается ли нода с проб в России. Сервер и Xray — сколько работают без перезапуска (жёлтым — Xray перезапускался меньше суток назад). CPU — load average на ядро. Трафик — клиентов за выбранный период, лимит — расход трафика ноды, если он задан в панели.

targets.expr: sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_connected{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_online_users{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_online_users{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) (((min by (ip) (label_replace(max by (name, address) (xray_proxy_status{check="xray"}), "ip", "$1", "address", "(.+):[0-9]+"))) * on (ip) group_right () rwmon_node_address{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) (((min by (ip) (label_replace(max by (name, address) (xray_proxy_status{check="warp"}), "ip", "$1", "address", "(.+):[0-9]+"))) * on (ip) group_right () rwmon_node_address{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) (((min by (ip) (label_replace(max by (name, address) (xray_proxy_status{check="psiphon"}), "ip", "$1", "address", "(.+):[0-9]+"))) * on (ip) group_right () rwmon_node_address{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) (((min by (ip) (label_replace(max by (address) (probe_success{kind="tcp"}), "ip", "$1", "address", "(.+):[0-9]+"))) * on (ip) group_right () rwmon_node_address{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_uptime_seconds{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_xray_uptime_seconds{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

max by (panel_title, node_name, xray) (rwmon_node_version{panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_cpu_load5{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_memory_used_ratio{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_network_rx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"} * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_network_tx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"} * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((sum by (panel, node_uuid) (increase(rwmon_node_inbound_upload_bytes{panel_title=~"$panel"}[$__range]) + increase(rwmon_node_inbound_download_bytes{panel_title=~"$panel"}[$__range]))) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_traffic_used_bytes{panel_title=~"$panel"} / rwmon_node_traffic_limit_bytes{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Сейчас не работает
panels.description: Хосты, которые не проходят проверку прямо сейчас, и сколько времени назад проверка проходила последний раз (в пределах суток). «из РФ» — ни одна проба в России не может открыть соединение с хостом.

targets.expr: (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (name) group_left (check) ((time() - max by (name, check) (max_over_time(timestamp(xray_proxy_status{check="xray"} == 1)[1d:1m]))) and on (name) (max by (name) (xray_proxy_status{check="xray"}) == 0))) or ((rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="xray"}) == 0) * 0 + 86400) or (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) ((time() - max by (name, check) (max_over_time(timestamp(xray_proxy_status{check="warp"} == 1)[1d:1m]))) and on (name) (max by (name) (xray_proxy_status{check="warp"}) == 0))) or ((rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="warp"}) == 0) * 0 + 86400) or (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) ((time() - max by (name, check) (max_over_time(timestamp(xray_proxy_status{check="psiphon"} == 1)[1d:1m]))) and on (name) (max by (name) (xray_proxy_status{check="psiphon"}) == 0))) or ((rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="psiphon"}) == 0) * 0 + 86400) or (label_replace(rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (address) group_left () (max by (address) (probe_success{kind="tcp"}) == 0), "check", "ru", "", "") * 0 + 0)

panels.title: Панели
panels.description: Трафик «из API» округлён панелью — для точного укажите metrics_url в config.toml

targets.expr: max by (panel_title) (rwmon_panel_up{panel_title=~"$panel"})
max by (panel_title, version) (rwmon_panel_info{panel_title=~"$panel"})
max by (panel_title) (rwmon_panel_traffic_exact{panel_title=~"$panel"})
sum by (panel_title) (rwmon_users_total{panel_title=~"$panel"})

panels.title: Сайты
panels.description: Сайты из [[site]] в config.toml: проверка с сервера мониторинга и с проб в России, время ответа и сколько осталось до конца сертификата

targets.expr: max by (site) (rwmon_site_up)
max by (site) (probe_success{kind="http"})
max by (site) (rwmon_site_response_seconds)
max by (site) (rwmon_site_cert_expiry_timestamp_seconds - time())

panels.title: Клиенты онлайн
panels.description: По панелям, слоями: высота — сколько всего клиентов

targets.expr: sum by (panel_title) (rwmon_node_online_users{panel_title=~"$panel"})

panels.title: Сеть всех нод
panels.description: Вверх от нуля — принято серверами (RX), вниз пунктиром — отправлено (TX)

targets.expr: sum by (panel_title) (rwmon_node_network_rx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * 8
sum by (panel_title) (rwmon_node_network_tx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * 8

panels.title: Аутбаунды: $outbound
panels.description: Все ноды вместе. Вверх — ответы из аутбаунда, вниз — запросы в него. Если запросы есть, а ответов нет — аутбаунд сломан

targets.expr: sum by (tag) (rate(rwmon_node_outbound_download_bytes{tag=~"$outbound", panel_title=~"$panel"}[5m])) * 8
sum by (tag) (rate(rwmon_node_outbound_upload_bytes{tag=~"$outbound", panel_title=~"$panel"}[5m])) * 8

panels.title: $node
panels.description: Сеть сервера ноды: вверх — принято (RX), вниз — отправлено (TX). Пунктиром — сколько пришло из выбранных аутбаундов (WARP, Psiphon)

targets.expr: sum by (node) ((rwmon_node_network_rx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"} * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (node) ((rwmon_node_network_tx_bytes_per_second{panel_title=~"$panel"} * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (tag) ((rate(rwmon_node_outbound_download_bytes{tag=~"$outbound", panel_title=~"$panel"}[5m]) * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_online_users{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((sum by (panel, node_uuid) (rate(rwmon_node_inbound_download_bytes{panel_title=~"$panel"}[5m])) * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((sum by (panel, node_uuid) (rate(rwmon_node_inbound_upload_bytes{panel_title=~"$panel"}[5m])) * 8) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_cpu_load5{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

sum by (panel_title, node_name) ((rwmon_node_memory_used_ratio{panel_title=~"$panel"}) * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node_name, panel_title) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Подключение
panels.description: Строка — хост, колонка — панель. Одинаковые хосты разных панелей проверяются один раз

targets.expr: max by (panel_title, host) (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="xray"}))

panels.title: WARP
panels.description: Строка — хост, колонка — панель. Одинаковые хосты разных панелей проверяются один раз. Лёгкие (LTE) хосты здесь не проверяются

targets.expr: max by (panel_title, host) (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="warp"}))

panels.title: Psiphon
panels.description: Строка — хост, колонка — панель. Одинаковые хосты разных панелей проверяются один раз. Лёгкие (LTE) хосты здесь не проверяются

targets.expr: max by (panel_title, host) (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="psiphon"}))

panels.title: История сбоев
panels.description: Только хосты, у которых за выбранный период были сбои

targets.expr: (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="xray"})) and on (name) (min by (name) (min_over_time(xray_proxy_status{check="xray"}[$__range] @ end())) == 0) or (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="warp"})) and on (name) (min by (name) (min_over_time(xray_proxy_status{check="warp"}[$__range] @ end())) == 0) or (rwmon_host{panel_title=~"$panel", lite="0"} * on (name) group_left (check) max by (name, check) (xray_proxy_status{check="psiphon"})) and on (name) (min by (name) (min_over_time(xray_proxy_status{check="psiphon"}[$__range] @ end())) == 0)

panels.title: Не открывалось из РФ
panels.description: Адреса хостов, которые хотя бы раз за период не открылись с какой-нибудь пробы в России. Если сбой на одной пробе — скорее всего, проблема у самой RU-ноды; если на всех — блокировка.

targets.expr: (max by (address, probe) (probe_success{kind="tcp"}) * on (address) group_left (hosts) rwmon_address_info) and on (address, probe) (min by (address, probe) (min_over_time(probe_success{kind="tcp"}[$__range] @ end())) == 0)

panels.title: Время соединения из РФ
panels.description: Сколько занимает установка соединения с проб в России до каждого адреса

targets.expr: max by (address, probe) (probe_duration_seconds{kind="tcp"}) * on (address) group_left (hosts) rwmon_address_info

panels.title: Как сервисы видят ноды
panels.description: Страна, которую определяет каждый сервис (последний GeoCheck). Красным — RU и BY

targets.expr: max by (node, service, value) (rwmon_geocheck{group=~"services", panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Доступ к сервисам
panels.description: Открывается ли сервис с IP ноды (Netflix, ChatGPT и т.п.) и в каком регионе

targets.expr: max by (node, service, value) (rwmon_geocheck{group=~"stash", panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: GeoIP-базы и CDN
panels.description: Что о стране IP ноды записано в базах GeoIP и что видят CDN

targets.expr: max by (node, service, value) (rwmon_geocheck{group=~"geoip|cdn", panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: IP нод
panels.description: IP, сеть и тип IP по последнему GeoCheck. Риск — оценка репутации IP (0–100)

targets.expr: max by (node, ip, network, ip_type, place, consensus) (rwmon_geocheck_info{panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))
max by (node) (rwmon_geocheck_risk{panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))

max by (node) (time() - rwmon_geocheck_timestamp_seconds{panel_title=~"$panel"} * on (panel, node_uuid) group_left (node) topk by (panel, node_uuid) (1, rwmon_node_info{panel_title=~"$panel", node=~"$node"}))
